login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Book a load, follow your shipments and keep your documents in one place.
login.carrierNote: Your account is hosted by the carrier company that invited you. Booking a load sends the order straight to their dispatcher.
signup.title: Create your account
signup.lead: Two minutes, no paperwork: company details are optional and can be completed later.
signup.name: Your name
signup.verificationNote: Email and phone verification need a delivery provider that is not connected yet — your account works meanwhile and the portal shows the state honestly.
shipments.title: Shipments
shipments.lead: Everything you have booked, with the live status of the trip.
shipments.empty: No shipments yet. Book your first load and it appears here.
book.title: Book a load
book.lead: Route, cargo, dates — then choose how you want to ship it.
book.special: Reefer temperature, customs T1/TIR, loading help, appointment…
book.pay.invoice: On account — carrier invoices after POD
book.pay.escrowNote: Escrow needs the owner's merchant-of-record decision (UXF-OWN1); invoice-first is what works today.
book.sectionSupply: How do you want to ship this?
book.supply.lead: Every option is explained — nothing is a dead end.
book.supply.fleetDesc: Browse verified fleets: filter by lane, equipment, rating, ETA and price band.
book.supply.soloDesc: Beacon board of owner-operators: who is empty, where, and available from when.
book.supply.autoDesc: The engine ranks fleets and solo drivers by price, ETA, rating and reliability.
book.supply.ownCarrierDesc: Book directly with a carrier you already work with, on or off RoadwiseFleet.
book.supply.recurringDesc: Agreed rate card per lane with a weekly or monthly schedule.
book.supply.offPlatform: My carrier is not on RoadwiseFleet
book.supply.offPlatformDesc: We create the order here and send your carrier a job link by WhatsApp or SMS — they need no account.
book.carrierKind.on: Yes — send them the booking request
book.carrierKind.off: No — send them a job link
book.carrierKind.note: Either way the order is created and your dispatcher sees it immediately.
book.marketplacePending: The marketplace opens with UXF-M1 (#76). Your choice is recorded and nothing is lost — until then, book with your own carrier (on or off RoadwiseFleet) and the load goes to your dispatcher today.
book.marketplaceFallback: Book with my own carrier instead
book.marketplacePosted: Load posted to the marketplace. Carriers' offers appear on the Offers screen — compare them there.
book.offPlatformNote: Order created with a job link for your carrier.
book.created: Order created. Your carrier's dispatcher can see it now.
shipment.heading: Shipment
shipment.trackNone: No live tracking link yet — create one to share this shipment with your consignee.
offers.title: Offers
offers.lead: Carriers answer your posted load with a structured offer. Compare them on one screen — price, pickup and delivery ETA, rating, truck, verification and cancellation terms — then counter, decline or award.
offers.noLoads: No loads posted yet. Choose a marketplace option when you book and the load appears here.
offers.empty: No offers yet. Refresh in a moment — carriers browsing the board see your load.
offers.declined: Offer declined — your load stays open.
offers.awarded: Awarded. The trip is created, both sides notified — track it under Shipments.
offers.awardedNoNotice: Awarded. The trip is created and appears under Shipments.
offers.err.offerClosed: That offer is no longer open.
offers.err.loadNotFound: We could not find that load.
offers.err.offerNotFound: We could not find that offer.
autoMatch.title: Auto-match rules
autoMatch.lead: Set the limits the engine may use to pick an offer automatically: a maximum price and a minimum carrier rating. Enabling is gated on the owner's matching-limits decision.
autoMatch.gate: Auto-match stays off until the owner answers the matching limits ({gate}). Your limits are saved and take effect then.
account.title: Account
account.name: Your name
account.prefsLead: Where we reach you about a booking or a delivery.
account.teamLead: Everyone here can book and track for this account.
account.team.name: Teammate name
account.teamInvited: Teammate added — share the temporary password with them privately.
account.addressesLead: Saved addresses appear as suggestions when you book.
account.address.label: Label

book.error.supplyUnknown: That shipping option is not available.
book.error.equipmentUnknown: Choose an equipment type from the list.
book.error.windowOrder: The delivery date cannot be before the loading date.
book.error.pricingUnknown: Choose a pricing mode from the list.
book.error.amountInvalid: Enter a number of zero or more.
book.error.payerUnknown: Choose who pays from the list.
book.error.escrowUnavailable: Escrow is not available yet (UXF-OWN1). Choose invoice, card, SEPA or pay on delivery.
book.error.paymentUnknown: Choose a payment method from the list.
signup.error.formInvalid: Please check the form and try again.
signup.error.emailInvalid: That email address does not look right.
signup.error.passwordShort: Use at least 8 characters for your password.
signup.error.phoneInvalid: Enter a phone number we can reach you on.
account.error.formInvalid: Please check the form and try again.
error.invalidCredentials: Email or password is not correct.
error.accountLocked: This account is locked for 15 minutes after too many attempts.
error.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Sign in again.
error.forbidden: This account may not do that.
error.badRequest: Some of the details are not valid — check the highlighted fields.
error.conflict: That action is not possible in the current state — refresh and try again.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts — wait a minute and try again.
error.emailTaken: That email address already has an account.
error.noCarrierOrg: The portal is not connected to a carrier company yet. Contact support.
